newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: SOCCER-HEERENVEEN SINK FEYENOORD IN DUTCH CUP.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-HEERENVEEN SINK FEYENOORD IN DUTCH CUP.

text.p: Two late goals gave unfancied Heerenveen a shock 2-1 win against Feyenoord in the quarter-finals of the Dutch Cup on Wednesday.
The Dutch league's leading scorer, Dane John Dahl Tomasson, grabbed the winner seven minutes from time, firing home from short range after a cross by Igor Korneev.

Feyenoord, currently second in the league, left out regular strikers Henke Larsson and Gaston Taument. And the move appeared to pay off when they took the lead after 24 minutes when Henk Vos latched on to a Pablo Sanchez through-ball to beat goalkeeper Hans Vonk.
Feyenoord keeper Ed de Goey made a string of second-half saves to keep his side, cup winners four times in the last six years, in the game.
But, with 12 minutes left, striker Leroy Echteld levelled the scores, sweeping in a Boudewijn Pahlplatz cross, and Tomasson completed the comeback.
In another upset, second division Helmond Sport came from behind to knock out fith-placed Vitesse Arnhem 2-1.
The first division side went ahead after four minutes through Roy Makaay but goals by Pascal Boer in the 55th minute and Dennis Gerritsen in the 71st booked Helmond a surprise semifinal berth.
Willem II and Roda JC have already qualified for the last four in a competition that has already seen champions Ajax Amsterdam and league leaders PSV Eindhoven crash out.
